name: Foam Roller Calf Roll
steps: Sit with one calf across the roller, the other foot planted and both hands on the floor behind you.
Lift your hips slightly off the floor and roll slowly from just above your ankle up to just below the back of your knee.
Rotate your leg gently inward and outward to work the inner, center, and outer areas of the calf, pausing briefly on tender spots.
Continue rolling smoothly for the target duration on one leg, then switch sides.
tips: Avoid rolling directly over the back of your knee joint or Achilles tendon.
Keep your breathing slow and relaxed so the calf muscles release tension.
